ratings_why.fun: Age as a movable resource, with oldest/youngest as targeting, gives real routing choices each turn: Netopir and Echo Bat feeding fresh Hatchlings, or tipping a Clutch-Sister over its threshold.
ratings_why.distinct: Movable, spendable Age is clearly apart from Hedgerow's slot clocks, though the Long Sleep build still plays like a generic wait-and-scale tribe.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; the remaining notes are ideas that would make it different rather than better.

points.text: Brother Netopir into a fresh Gilled Hatchling turns every relay into +N/+N, since Hatchling counts Age it gains, not Age it ages. A great unlisted combo; worth naming in the Relay build so players find it.

Old Polh with Mother Ribica feeds itself: two Hams give 4 Age, enough to reach the next step every turn, so it can print Hams forever. Fun as a pivot, but the owner should know it is a steady 4 gold a turn.
Seven-Month Dormouse only spends its own Age. Letting it spend Age from a unit next to it would make it a real choice against thresholds next door.
The Long Sleep build has no decisions after turn 6. One card that rewards breaking Still once, like Parkelj does at Tier 5, would give it a mid-game choice.

standouts.why: Geometry-based relay that makes awakened Age useful again and combos with Hatchling, Clutch-Sister and the Eldest.
Reads oldest to feed youngest, so it ties the two targeting words together and rewards one very old unit beside a fresh carry.
The rule-breaker that lets the combat build rearrange for the Robber-Knight without losing Age.

weakest.why: Kurent Bellman is a flat aura with one placement choice; it does the obvious job and nothing else.
Cloister Warden only matters in the half-Olm build; in a pure Olm board it does almost nothing.
Dragon of the Springs just counts total Age, so it rewards the same thing as everything else without a decision of its own.

flags.note: Old Polh plus Mother Ribica self-feeds with its own Hams: 2 Hams and 4 gold or 4 Age every turn, indefinitely.
"This Awaken never happens again" doesn't say whether a second Eldest, or a golden made from it, can still Awaken 20.
